title: Code Review Findings
description: Structured output schema for code review sub-agents

reviewer.description: Persona name that produced this output (e.g., 'correctness', 'security')

findings.description: List of code review findings. Empty array if no issues found.

title.description: Short, specific issue title. 10 words or fewer.

file.description: Relative file path from repository root

line.description: Primary line number of the issue

why_it_matters.description: Impact and failure mode -- not 'what is wrong' but 'what breaks'

autofix_class.description: Routing hint for the caller after review. gated_auto = concrete suggested_fix proposed. manual = needs design decisions. advisory = report-only.

owner.description: Who should own the next action for this finding after synthesis

requires_verification.description: Whether any fix for this finding must be re-verified with targeted tests

suggested_fix.description: Concrete minimal fix. Propose whenever a defensible code change is reachable from review context. Omit only when there is genuinely no code-level change to propose.

confidence.description: Anchored confidence score. 0: false positive. 25: speculative. 50: real but minor. 75: confirmed will affect users. 100: verifiable from code alone.

evidence.description: Code-grounded evidence: snippets, line references, or pattern descriptions. At least 1 item.

pre_existing.description: True if this issue exists in unchanged code unrelated to the current diff

residual_risks.description: Risks the reviewer noticed but could not confirm as findings

testing_gaps.description: Missing test coverage the reviewer identified

confidence_anchors.0: False positive or pre-existing -- do not report
confidence_anchors.25: Speculative; could not verify -- do not report
confidence_anchors.50: Verified real but minor or stylistic -- report only when P0 or routed to soft buckets
confidence_anchors.75: Highly confident, will affect users or runtime in normal usage -- report
confidence_anchors.100: Verifiable from code alone (compile error, type mismatch, definitive logic bug) -- report

severity_definitions.P0: Critical breakage, exploitable vulnerability, data loss/corruption. Must fix before merge.
severity_definitions.P1: High-impact defect likely hit in normal usage, breaking contract. Should fix.
severity_definitions.P2: Moderate issue with meaningful downside. Fix if straightforward.
severity_definitions.P3: Low-impact, narrow scope, minor improvement. User's discretion.

autofix_classes.gated_auto: Concrete suggested_fix proposed. Caller may apply after judgment.
autofix_classes.manual: Actionable issue requiring design decisions or cross-cutting changes.
autofix_classes.advisory: Informational or operational item for the report only.

owners.downstream-resolver: Caller or human should act after review.
